buildCommand: buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/src/. --local dockerfile=/src/controller --opt platform=linux/{{.Arch}} --opt "build-arg:BUILD_VERSION=$BUILD_VERSION" --opt "build-arg:GIT_VERSION=$GIT_VERSION" --opt "build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --output type=oci,dest=/src/bin/nvke-controller-image-{{.Arch}}.oci.tar,oci-mediatypes=true

buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/src/. --local dockerfile=/src/nvkr-controller-profiles --opt platform=linux/{{.Arch}} --opt "build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --output type=oci,dest=/src/bin/nvke-controller-profiles-image-{{.Arch}}.oci.tar,oci-mediatypes=true

patches.content:
diff --git a/nvkr-controller-profiles/Dockerfile b/nvkr-controller-profiles/Dockerfile
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-controller-profiles/Dockerfile
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+# The pinned Alpine base supplies /bin/sh and cp for the chart materializer.
+# This packages source fixtures; it does not supply fleet deployment settings.
+FROM docker.io/library/alpine@sha256:294b683cb724975bec92580e1e685676bd4b50bda910ddb8c51d4cabeaec77e6
+COPY controller/test/fixtures/profiles/ /profiles/
+COPY controller/test/fixtures/runbooks/ /profiles/runbooks/
patches.name: patches/profiles-image.patch

buildCommand:
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor
make -C cli build NVKECTL_TREE=clean
vendorCommand:
export GOENV=off GOWORK=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOFLAGS=
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
pins="$(sha256sum cli/go.mod cli/go.sum controller/api/go.mod controller/api/go.sum controller/deploy/charts/go.mod management-engine/go.mod management-engine/go.sum)"
cd cli
timeout --kill-after=10s 540s go mod download
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 60s go mod verify
GOPROXY=off timeout --kill-after=10s 180s go mod vendor
cd ..
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum --quiet -c -
test ! -e controller/deploy/charts/go.sum
